# pod5.cr

[![Test](https://github.com/kojix2/pod5.cr/actions/workflows/ci.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/kojix2/pod5.cr/actions/workflows/ci.yml)
[![Lines of Code](https://img.shields.io/endpoint?url=https%3A%2F%2Ftokei.kojix2.net%2Fbadge%2Fgithub%2Fkojix2%2Fpod5.cr%2Flines)](https://tokei.kojix2.net/github/kojix2/pod5.cr)

Crystal >= 1.22 bindings for POD5 metadata, raw/calibrated signals, read selection,
writing and VBZ compression. Uses the native POD5 library; no Python runtime.

## Installation

Requires a C++20 compiler, curl, tar, unzip, patch and SHA256 tools.
The installer supports Linux x86_64/ARM64 and macOS 14+ ARM64. It verifies pinned
downloads and builds the compatibility API for POD5 0.3.49.

```yaml
dependencies:
  pod5:
    github: kojix2/pod5.cr
```

In your application:

```sh
shards install
crystal run main.cr
```

The postinstall hook installs the native library; ordinary builds need no wrapper.
`POD5_NATIVE_PREFIX` selects an absolute prefix for both installation and compilation;
`POD5_DOWNLOAD_CACHE` selects the archive cache. Reinstallation reuses a matching
complete installation and rejects incompatible prefixes. Binaries embed an absolute
rpath: retain that native directory or adjust the deployment rpath. See
[THIRD_PARTY.md](THIRD_PARTY.md) for offline archives, native fixes and licenses.

## Read

```crystal
require "pod5"

Pod5::Reader.open("reads.pod5") do |reader|
  puts reader.size
  reader.each do |read|
    puts "#{read.read_id}: #{read.sample_count} samples"
    adc = read.signal    # Fresh Slice(Int16), loaded on demand.
    pa = read.signal_pa  # Fresh Slice(Float32), in picoamperes.
  end
end
```

`reader[id]?` looks up a UUID; `each_selected(ids)` selects reads in storage order.
Lazy records need an open reader for signal access; `read.materialize` detaches
a copy. Calibration is `(ADC + offset) * scale`.

## Write

```crystal
require "pod5"

run = Pod5::RunInfo.new(acquisition_id: UUID.random.to_s, sample_rate: 4000_u16)
metadata = Pod5::Metadata.new(run_info: run, channel: 1_u32,
  calibration_offset: 0_f32, calibration_scale: 0.25_f32)
Pod5::Writer.open("new.pod5") do |writer|
  writer.add(metadata, Slice[100_i16, 101_i16, 99_i16])
end
```

Use a new output path. Closing finalizes the file; exceptions do not roll back
earlier writes. `writer.add(record)` copies a reader record with its metadata.
`Pod5::VBZ.compress(signal)` and `decompress(bytes, sample_count)` handle VBZ.

## Development

From this checkout, also install OpenSSL headers and pkg-config for the tests:

```sh
sh scripts/install_native.sh
sh scripts/download_fixtures.sh
crystal spec
shards build
bin/pod5-info reads.pod5
```

License: MIT for the wrapper; MPL-2.0 for derived ABI declarations/native patches.
See [LICENSE](LICENSE) and [THIRD_PARTY.md](THIRD_PARTY.md).

types.name: Reader
types.doc:
One native batch is cached per reader. Calls and close are serialized.
User blocks run outside the lock and may use another reader or a writer.
types.summary: One native batch is cached per reader.

def.name: open
def.body:
reader = new(path, disable_mmap: disable_mmap)
begin
  yield reader
ensure
  reader.close
end

each_selected([id], strict: false) do |record| return record end
nil

def.name: batch_count
def.body:
@mutex.synchronize do
  ensure_open
  count = LibC::SizeT.new(0)
  Pod5.check(LibPod5.get_read_batch_count(pointerof(count), @handle), "batch count")
  count.to_i
end

def.name: close

instance_methods.name: each
instance_methods.doc: Streaming metadata iteration. No Enumerable or implicit collection.

def.name: each
def.body:
batch_count.times do |batch_index|
  rows = @mutex.synchronize do
    batch = load_batch(batch_index)
    count = LibC::SizeT.new(0)
    Pod5.check(LibPod5.get_read_batch_row_count(pointerof(count), batch), "batch row count")
    count.to_i
  end
  rows.times do |row| yield record_at(batch_index, row) end
end

instance_methods.name: each_selected
instance_methods.doc:
Deduplicates requests, then yields in storage order. With strict=true,
missing IDs raise before any record is yielded.
instance_methods.summary: Deduplicates requests, then yields in storage order.
instance_methods.args_string: (ids : Enumerable(UUID | String), *, strict : Bool = true, & : Record -> ) : Nil
instance_methods.args_html: (ids : Enumerable(UUID | String), *, strict : Bool = true, & : Record -> ) : Nil

def.name: each_selected
def.body:
requested = ids.map do |id| id.is_a?(UUID) ? id : UUID.new(id) end.uniq!.to_a
counts, rows = plan(requested, strict)
offset = 0
counts.each_with_index do |count, batch_index|
  count.times do
    yield record_at(batch_index, rows[offset].to_i)
    offset = offset + 1
  end
end

def.name: file_identifier
def.body:
@mutex.synchronize do
  ensure_open
  info = LibPod5::FileInfo.new
  Pod5.check(LibPod5.get_file_info(@handle, pointerof(info)), "file info")
  UUID.new(info.file_identifier)
end

def.name: finalize
def.body:
if @batch.null?
else
  LibPod5.free_read_batch(@batch)
end
if @handle.null?
else
  LibPod5.close_and_free_reader(@handle)
end

def.name: read_ids
def.body:
@mutex.synchronize do
  ensure_open
  count = LibC::SizeT.new(0)
  Pod5.check(LibPod5.get_read_count(@handle, pointerof(count)), "read count")
  if count == 0
    return [] of UUID
  end
  ids = Slice(LibPod5::ReadId).new(count.to_i) do StaticArray(UInt8, 16).new(0_u8) end
  Pod5.check(LibPod5.get_read_ids(@handle, count, ids), "read IDs")
  Array(UUID).new(ids.size) do |i| UUID.new(ids[i]) end
end

def.name: run_infos
def.body:
@mutex.synchronize do
  ensure_open
  count = 0_u16
  Pod5.check(LibPod5.get_file_run_info_count(@handle, pointerof(count)), "run count")
  Array(RunInfo).new(count.to_i) do |i|
    pointer = Pointer(LibPod5::RunInfoDictData).null
    Pod5.check(LibPod5.get_file_run_info(@handle, i.to_u16, pointerof(pointer)), "run info")
    copy_run(pointer)
  end
end

def.name: size
def.body:
@mutex.synchronize do

  count.to_u64
end

def.name: compress
def.body:
Pod5.init
capacity = LibPod5.vbz_compressed_signal_max_size(signal.size)
if capacity == 0
  Pod5.check(LibPod5.get_error_no, "VBZ maximum size")
end
output = Bytes.new(capacity.to_i)
size = LibC::SizeT.new(output.size)
dummy = 0_i16
pointer = signal.empty? ? pointerof(dummy) : signal.to_unsafe
Pod5.check(LibPod5.vbz_compress_signal(pointer, signal.size, output, pointerof(size)), "VBZ compress")
output[0, size.to_i]

def.name: decompress
def.body:
if sample_count < 0
  raise(ArgumentError.new("sample_count must not be negative"))
end
result = Slice(Int16).new(sample_count.to_i)
decompress_into(data, result)

def.name: decompress_into
def.body:
Pod5.init
if data.empty?
  raise(ArgumentError.new("compressed data must not be empty"))
end
dummy = 0_i16
pointer = output.empty? ? pointerof(dummy) : output.to_unsafe
Pod5.check(LibPod5.vbz_decompress_signal(data, data.size, output.size, pointer), "VBZ decompress")
output

writer = new(path, **options)
begin
  yield writer
ensure
  writer.close
end
